rationale: User-requested Figure4-style caption investigation; InstructBLIP is a separate instruction-tuned caption ablation, not the BLIP2 paper baseline.
prompt: Describe this image comprehensively, focusing on all visible text elements. Include: the setting or environment (indoor/outdoor, urban/rural); main text-containing objects (signs, displays, documents); text placement and arrangement (centered, peripheral, overlapping); and contextual elements that provide semantic cues. Write one coherent paragraph of 40 to 80 words describing what is visible. Return only the description.
hardware_deviation: CPU FP32 batch1 sequential model; actual CUDA qualification remains pending.
